status: accepted parent-star relationship and DOS PAR coordinates; F02 planet properties, orbit, landing, and surface remain open
initial_state: Each of three fresh disposable DOS roots received ../F01C_MIRACLE/seed-current.bin as data/CURRENT.BIN. This fixture reuses the hashed GOESnet console pose; it does not reuse an F01D target save.
steps: For each query, copy the pinned data/, modules/, and dosbox.conf into a separate disposable root. Verify the reference and seed hashes, mount the root as N: in DOSBox-X, switch to N:, cd modules, run NOCTIS.EXE, and press Enter if the boot screen waits.

At the seeded GOESnet console, press Home and Backspace as needed to clear the input line. Enter PAR FELYSIA and press Enter. Preserve the 147-byte data/GOESFILE.TXT result as par-felysia.txt. Repeat PAR FELYSIA in a second fresh root; its raw output must be byte-identical.

In a third fresh root, enter PAR BALASTRACKONASTREYA. Preserve the 147-byte result as par-balastrackonastreya.txt. The 21-character GOESnet name field truncates the long star name, but its returned coordinates must match the FELYSIA result.

Exit each run normally. Read the pinned starmap's eight-byte ID and 24-byte label records at the offsets below. For P04, subtract planet number 4 from FELYSIA's ID and compare exactly to the BALASTRACKONASTREYA star ID. Do not infer a relationship from name similarity.
